name: Ashikaga Shion
source:
B is the protagonist of the game. She's an entomology university student dealing with depression. B has a dry sense of humor, doing everything half-heartedly. She's also very fond of bugs and thinks of them as her only friends.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/teamrobo/tomorrow-will-be-dying-a-university-life-sim-visual-novel?ref=creator_nav]Kickstarter[/url]]
